findings.issue: Layout originally used <RouterOutlet/> inside the route layout, causing SSR infinite recursion that took ~14 turns to debug (trace turns 51-66)
findings.suggestion: Before inventing framework structure (the starter template has no layout.tsx), consult Qwik City docs/skills — layouts use <Slot/>, RouterOutlet belongs only in root.tsx

findings.issue: Zero documentation, web, MCP or skill consultation across the entire 118-turn session, despite being unsure about core APIs (RouterOutlet, useComputed, RequestEvent)
findings.suggestion: When unsure of a framework API, one doc lookup or MCP query is far cheaper than 14 turns of bisection

findings.issue: HTTP 404 status intentionally skipped (spec says 'encouraged but not tested') without any experimental check that status(404)/fail(404) would be safe (trace turn 112)
findings.suggestion: Spend one turn adding fail(404) in the routeLoaders and re-running the suite; the reasoning-for-risk was done but the cheap experiment wasn't

findings.issue: `pkill -f 'vite preview'` matched its own bash command line and killed the shell (exit 143)
findings.suggestion: Kill by recorded PID or use a pattern that can't match the invoking command

findings.issue: Three heredoc write failures: missing mkdir for src/lib, malformed catch-all route dir creation leaving a warning, and a Python SyntaxError inside a bash heredoc
findings.suggestion: Use a dedicated write/edit tool or mkdir -p before heredocs; keep multi-line patches out of shell quoting

findings.issue: First recursion hypothesis (Qwik serializer overflowing on the 1026-entry catalog) was wrong and cost ~4 turns before being disproven
findings.suggestion: Test the simplest discriminator first (does a trivial page render?) — which it eventually did at turn 59

summary: A disciplined, mostly linear session: thorough spec/test/data reconnaissance up front, data-driven architecture choices, and verification that went well beyond the test suite (pixel measurements, both viewports, interactive URL/pagination checks, full suite after the final edit). The one significant blemish is a self-inflicted 14-turn SSR recursion bug (RouterOutlet instead of Slot in the layout) that was debugged systematically but would have been prevented by a single doc lookup — zero doc/web/MCP use all session — plus a handful of shell fumbles.
